description: A debouncer. Module `debounce` with a parameter N (default 4), inputs clk, rst_n (active-low reset) and din, and output dout. din is already synchronous to clk. dout takes din's new value only once din has differed from dout at N consecutive rising clock edges; dout changes at the Nth of those edges. Shorter changes are ignored. After reset dout is 0.
